senses.gloss:
वज्र- + आभ वज्र- + आभ,
 I. adj. like a diamond.
 II. m. a precious opal.
वज्र- + दशन वज्र- + दशन, m. a rat.
वज्र- + निष्पेष वज्र- + निष्पेष, m. a clap of thunder.
वज्र- + पाणि वज्र- + पाणि, m. Indra.
वज्र- + रद वज्र- + रद, m. a hog.
वज्र- + लेप वज्र- + लेप, m. a kind of ointment (?), Pañc. iv. d. 10 (Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2704, pitch); cf. Wilson, Th. of the Hind. 2. ed. ii. p. 55.

† 1. वज् वज्, i. 1, Par. To go.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. vagari.

2. वज् वज्, i. 10, Par.
 1. (rather Caus. of a lost vb. वज्, probably ‘To increase, to be strong;’ cf. वज्र, उग्र, ओजस्), To strengthen, Lass. 99, 7 = Rigv. iii. 62, 8.
 2. † To prepare the way.
 3. † (rather a denomin. derived from वाज), To trim or feather an arrow.
 4. † To go.
 --Cf. Lat. vegere and augere, probably vigor, vigere; ὑγιής; O.H.G. auhôn; A.S. eacan, see वक्ष्; probably also A.S. wacor, cf. Icel. vakr; A.S. wácian.

वज्र 2. वज् + र,
 I. adj.
 1. Hard.
 2. Cross, forked.
 II. m. and n.
 1. Indra's thunderbolt, a thunderbolt, Bhartṛ. 2, 32; Hit. ii. d. 158.
 2. A diamond, Johns. Sel. 54, 136; Ragh. 1, 4; Rām. 3, 53, 59(?).
 3. A form of array, Man. 7, 191.
 4. The blossom of the sesamum.
 5. n. Emblic myrobalan, Pañc. iv. d. 10(?).
 6. Sour gruel.
 7. Harsh language.
 8. A child or pupil.
 III. f. रा, A plant, Menispermum cordifolium.
 IV. f. रा and री, A species of Euphorbia.
 --Cf. O.H.G. weggi; A.S. waecg, wecg, cuneus, which probably was also the original signification of the Indian sbst.
वज्रकपाटमन्त् वज्र-कपाट + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Having doors of diamond, Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 18.

वज्रकीलाय वज्रकीलाय, a denomin. derived from वज्र-कील with य, Ātm. To act like a thunderbolt.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वज्रकीलयित, Struck as by thunderbolts, Utt. Rāmac. 30, 2.
वज्रधर वज्र-धर, and वज्रभृत् वज्र-भृ + त्, m. Indra, Rām. 3, 53, 60; Lass. 2. ed. 76, 49.
वज्रमय वज्र + मय, adj., f. यी, Hard, adamantine, Utt. Rāmac. 164, 6.
वज्रिन् वज्रिन्, i. e. वज्र + इन्, m. Indra, Vikr. d. 5.

वाज वाज, i. e. वज् + अ,
 I. m. and n. A wing (see comp.).
 II. m.
 1. Food, sacrificial food, Chr. 288, 11 = Rigv. i. 48, 11.
 2. Battle, Chr. 291, 5 = Rigv. i. 85, 5.
 3. Speed.
 4. The feather of an arrow.
 5. Sound.
 III. n.
 1. Clarified butter.
 2. Water.
 3. Rice.
 4. The acidulous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. perhaps Engl. wing.

वाजिन् वाजिन्, i. e. वाज + इन्,
 I. adj. Swift, Chr. 290, 6 = Rigv. i. 64, 6.
 II. m.
 1. A sacrificer, Chr. 292, 3 = i. 86, 3.
 2. A horse, Pañc. 218, 7; Rājat. 5, 143.
 3. An arrow.
 4. A bird.
 III. f. नी, A mare.
 --Comp.
वाजिन वाजिन i. e. वाज + इन् + अ, n. The scum of curdled milk, Hemac. 3, 495 (= 831, Böhtl.).
वाजिनीवन्त् वाजिन् + ई + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Possessed of sacrifices(?), Chr. 287, 6 = Rigv. i. 48, 6.
वाज- + साति वाज- + साति, f. gain of food, Chr. 298, 24 = Rigv. i. 112, 24.

वज्र- + सार वज्र- + सार,
 I. adj. having the vigour of a thunderbolt, Pañc. 58, 10.
 II. m. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 226.
